entry.name: capture~
entry.digest: Store a signal to view as text
entry.description: Use the capture object to collect signal values for signal debugging or investigation. To record signal values, use the record~ or sfrecord~ object.

arguments.name: behavioral-flag (f)
arguments.description: If the first argument is the letter,stores the first signal samples it receives, and then ignores subsequent samples once its storage buffer is full. If the letteris not present,stores the most recent signal samples it has received, discarding earlier samples if necessary.

arguments.name: maximum-samples
arguments.description: Limits the number of samples (and thus the length of the excerpt) that can be held by. If no number is typed in,stores 4096 samples. The maximum possible number of samples is limited only by the amount of memory available to the Max application. A second number argument may be typed in to set the precision (the number of digits to the right of the decimal point) with which samples will be shown in the editing window. When set to mc mode (), thevalue applies to each channel. Captured values are displayed in sequence by channel number.

arguments.name: signal-vector-indices (up to 10 ints)
arguments.digest: List of indices within a signal vector
arguments.description: A list of up to 10 indices within a signal vector. If no indices present,records the entire vector.

messages.description: Double-clicking onopens a window for viewing and editing its contents. The numbers in the editing window can be copied and pasted into a graphicediting window.

messages.name: open
messages.description: Causes an editing and viewing window for theobject to become visible. The window is also brought to the front.

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: Store a signal portion as text for viewing, editing, or saving
messages.description: An excerpt of the signal is stored as text for viewing, editing, or saving to a file. (The length of the excerpt can be specified as a typed-in argument to the object.)

messages.name: wclose
messages.description: Closes the window associated with theobject.

messages.name: write
messages.digest: Saves the contents ofto a text file
messages.description: Saves the contents ofinto a text file. A standard file dialog is opened for naming the file. The word, followed by a symbol, saves the file, using the symbol as the filename, in the same folder as the patch containing the. If the patch has not yet been saved, thefile is saved in the same folder as the Max application.
